# Zaid Torres Salinas 

![](images\Zaid_UNGA.jpeg)

<div style="border: 4px solid #2C3E50; border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; font-size: 22px; background-color: #2C3E50; color: white;">

My name is Zaid Torres Salinas, and I am currently 22 years old. I was raised in Bryan, Texas, and currently live in New York City. I am the youngest of two siblings. One of my hobbies is ice skating, although I have not had the chance to explore the skating rinks around the city just yet. I also enjoy exploring new food spots and spending time with friends, especially when I can combine the two.
